pass_a_gloss: Sheep of slaughter; strange-god hands searched; wolves met as sent.
pass_b_english: In this life we are reckoned as sheep — 'we are reckoned as sheep of slaughter' (Psalm 44:21–22) — who know the secrets of the heart. If we spread our hands to a strange god, God who searches hearts shall find it out. But stretching hands to him in confession, we are sent as sheep in wolves' midst, and the wolves cannot devour whom the Shepherd keeps. 'Son, honor the Lord, and thou shalt be strong' (Matthew 10:16) — honoring him by confession unto death.
